body.purpose: Read current snapshot availability for catalog books.
when_to_use: Read current snapshot availability for catalog books.
when_not_to_use: Do not answer historical stock questions using this snapshot; no historical parameter exists.

rules: all, out_of_stock, low_stock, in_stock are exact enum values.
Supply distinct known IDs or null for all.

preconditions: Read bookstore://reference for vendor IDs and fixed clock.
Use ISO paired dates, known IDs, and no unsupported parameters.
